Hey guys, here's what we can do for some things. It is based off of the subs that I moderate and how we do things.

  • Have clearly defined rules; I'll reply to this comment with the rules that we have on one of my subs

  • Never use RNGs, we should be focussed on the stats of a country for finding out who does what

  • Until we get a wiki, keep everything organized on Google Docs. You do not need to have an account to edit or view Google docs. We can have them linked in the sidebar

  • Conflicts should be handled with Google Docs powered calculators. I am able to share the calculator that i use if you guys want it

  • User flairs should not be so customized since it takes up more CSS space; it should just be plaintext with maybe a border.

  • Don't have all nations equal -- from what I've seen, people do not appreciate an equal playing field. Some people find it fun to play international superpowers, and some people find it fun to play dictatorships or weak countries. Everybody plays differently and the countries should not be all equal in power

  • If nations are to start off equally, modern nation borders should not be used. What /r/HistoricalWorldPowers does is they have a blank map divided into provinces (I can link such a map upon request) and they have a player claim nine provinces. It is completely up to the player to come up with their culture, backstory and political alignment.

  • For split nations (China), there should be more clarification on how the military and resources are split.

  • Stop removing posts unless it is grossly off-topic or something like that. Just flair them as invalid. Post flairs work just fine as far as I know.

  • Have a public list of banned users. This is controversial, but transparency is completely needed. I have it on my sub and it is great. It adds a new level of trust and connection between the community and the moderators.

No metagaming

Metagaming means to act on what you read in a [SECRET] post. Users who are caught metagaming will be given a stern warning, a three-day ban the second time they are caught, and a week long ban for each time they are caught after that.

No alt accounts

Only use this sub on your main account / a single account. If you are caught using more than one account you will be instantly and permanently banned on all accounts.

Be nice

This is a catch-all rule that we hope to never use. If you generally have a negative effect on the community and we receive a lot of complaints about you, you will no longer be welcome to the community and will be met with a ban of varying length, depending on the severity of your actions.

All claimant accounts must be 2 weeks old with 20 posts (this one probably shouldn't be used for Voat)

This rule is to prevent against mutli-accounting, and to make sure the people who play don't claim a country and instantly go inactive. If you're claiming an account, your account must be at least 2 weeks old and have at least 20 posts.

No lying/fluffing numbers to moderators

Lying and fluffing numbers to other players is totally fine, but do not lie to moderators. We know. Lying to us creates a ridiculous amount of extra work. You will be given a stern warning for a first offense, followed by a short ban, and if it gets out of hand, a permanent ban. If you are going to lie and fluff numbers, send us a modmail so everybody is on the same page.

Inactivity

After one week without a comment or post on your nation (without warning the mods beforehand) will leave your nation open to being claimed. This is especially true for the Great Powers, who should be as active as possible. If no-one claims your nation and you return you do not need to make a claim post, simply resume posting as normal.
